about: Front ZH0: Simplified Chinese strings that may equal their English source, each with a reason (plan front-i18n-zh.md §5.4): product and organisation names, catalogue acronyms, keys. Words with a Chinese form (OK 确定, Pulsar 脉冲星, Radio 射电) never. Keys are the lint's string ids: `catalog:<key>`, `map:<id>.<path>`, `original:<normalised original>`.

entries.catalog:app.name: product name (OpenVireo)
entries.original:HH:MM:SS: VIREO's time-format mask, a format code (as ja, ru, fr, hi)
entries.original:YYYY/MM/DD: VIREO's date-format mask, a format code (as ja, hi)
entries.original:V - Mv =: a distance-modulus formula label of symbols (as ja, ru, fr, hi)
entries.original:PDot (S/S):: a pulsar timing parameter symbol and its unit (as ja, hi)
entries.original:PEpoch (MJD):: a pulsar epoch symbol and its time scale (as ja, ru, hi)
entries.original:(km/sec): a unit (km/s), as VIREO writes it (as ja)
